sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    b=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    greens=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>=8:
            r0,c0=n['boundary'][0]; r1,c1=n['boundary'][2]
            greens.append(((r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2, b[(r0+r1)//2][(c0+c1)//2]))
    out={'greens':greens}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='p':
            r0,c0=n['boundary'][0]; r1,c1=n['boundary'][2]
            out['purple']=f"rows{r0}-{r1} cols{c0}-{c1}"
    return out
print('before', state())
# select right green (34,22), move UP to bridge rows, then RIGHT to right end
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':34,'col':22}]); print('selected right green', state())
r=action(['UP']); print('UP', state())
r=action(['RIGHT']); print('RIGHT1', state())
r=action(['RIGHT']); print('RIGHT2', state())
r=action(['RIGHT']); print('RIGHT3', state())
r=action(['RIGHT']); print('RIGHT4 (at purple wall?)', state(), 'changed', r['board_changed'])
print('done', last_action_result.get('level_completed'), last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
